verdict.rationale: Smooth is a browser-agent product, so previewing candidate actions before execution is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence documents an observe/plan or dry-run primitive. The closest features are adjacent: the live view lets you watch actions as they happen, and session extract reads page data. Neither shows candidate actions before the agent commits to them.

support.subject: As a developer, I can preview candidate actions on the current page (observe/plan) before committing the agent to act
